findings: [major] vulnerability — billing/reconcile.py:1: PARTNER_API_KEY live 'sk-live-…' secret committed to source; anyone with repo/history access can call the internal billing API as the service. Rotate now and load from env/secrets manager.
[major] edge-case — billing/reconcile.py:7: loop changed to range(1, len(rows)) silently skips rows[0]. [10,20,30] vs 60.0 returns False; [10.0] vs 0.0 returns True. Use sum(r.amount for r in rows).

[major] edge-case — billing/test_reconcile.py:4-12: existing test_reconcile_matches_expected_total now fails (50 != 60); new test passes even for 'return False'. Locking assertion: reconcile_ledger_rows([Row(amount=10.0)], 10.0) is True and reconcile_ledger_rows([Row(amount=10.0)], 0.0) is False.

[major] missing-validation — billing/reconcile.py:14-20: fetch_partner_balance has no status check, no timeout, no payload validation; 500/401 bodies raise JSONDecodeError/KeyError, network stalls hang, {'balance': null} leaks None downstream.

[minor] missing-validation — billing/reconcile.py:16: partner_id interpolated into the URL path unencoded; '../admin' or '1/x?y' retargets the authenticated request within the internal host. Validate shape and/or urllib.parse.quote(..., safe='').

[minor] edge-case — billing/reconcile.py:9: fixed 0.01 float tolerance accepts sub-cent discrepancies ([0.005] vs 0.0 → True) and can falsely reject large accumulated ledgers; prefer Decimal/integer cents.
[nitpick] — billing/reconcile.py:15: http_client referenced but not imported anywhere in the diff; NameError at first call unless an import exists outside the hunk.
result.summary: Adversarial (deep-review) lens review of the synthetic billing/reconcile.py diff. Rating: Critical (2/10). Two independently blocking issues — a hardcoded live API key and an off-by-one that drops the first ledger row from every reconciliation — plus unhandled failure modes on the new external HTTP call. The existing test will fail under this diff; the new test passes for a non-discriminating reason.
